item.title: How the Earliest Sisters Helped Shape the IBEW
item.description: Mary Honzik couldn’t have imagined her present-day IBEW sisters, women who string high-voltage power lines, wire complex construction projects, even serve as foremen supervising their union brothers on work sites.
